[[Travel Scroll to Dragon's Nest]] |level = {{Skill|combat|12}} |music = "[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#Mythic Warfare|Mythic Warfare]]" (During an [[Ender Dragon]] fight) |sublocations = *[[Dragon's Nest]] *[[Void Sepulture]] *[[Void Slate]] *[[Zealot Bruiser Hideout]] |mobs = *Ender Dragon *End Stone Protector *Enderman *Endermite *Nest Endermite *Obsidian Defender *Seer *Voidling Fanatic *Voidling Extremist *Zealot *Special Zealot *Zealot Bruiser |resources = *End Stone *Obsidian |prev_location = [[Spiders Den]]}} '''The End''' is a location that represents the vanilla Minecraft [[mcw:The End|End dimension]]. Like the vanilla Minecraft End Dimension, it is home to [[Enderman|Endermen]] and the [[Ender Dragon]]. {{ZoneText|Fight Endermen and Endermites.|Mine End Stone and Obsidian.|Travel to the &5Dragon's Nest&f.}} == Location == '''The End''' can be accessed from {{Zone|Spiders Den}} on the west side via the use of a launchpad, a player may use a portal on their island to access The End, or they may use the [[Travel Scrolls|Travel Scroll to The End]] to access The End from anywhere. Players must have {{Skl|Combat 12}} unlocked in order to access The End. The portal can be located in the {{Zone|Spiders Den}} at {{Coords|-382|89|-268}}. == Features == === Mobs === '''The End''' has [[Enderman|Endermen]] all throughout it. When [[End Stone]] is mined without a [[Stonk]] or when [[Ender Pearl]]s are used, there is a small chance an [[Endermite]] will spawn. In the Dragon's Nest, [[Zealot]]s, [[Obsidian Defender]]s and [[Seer]]s spawn. [[Endermite]]s also spawn naturally, as well as being spawned by [[Seer]]s. In the [[Void Sepulture]], much stronger Endermen called [[Voidling Fanatic]]s and [[Voidling Extremist]]s spawn. === Resources === There are 3 main resources found in '''The End''' - [[Obsidian]], [[End Stone]], and [[Ender Pearl]]s. [[Obsidian]] and [[End Stone]] can be obtained from mining, and [[Ender Pearl]]s will drop from slain [[Enderman|Endermen]] and [[Zealot]]s. There are three types of Zealots: normal [[Zealot]]s, [[Zealot|Ender Chest Zealots]] (which drop goodies when killed), and Portal Frame or Special [[Zealot]]s, which spawn rarely after killing normal or Ender Chest Zealots. They are weaker (2,000 Health) and drop [[Summoning Eye]]s. There are also [[Ender Armor]] and [[Summoning Eye]]s. Ender Armor is a rare drop from [[Enderman|Endermen]]. [[Summoning Eye]]s can be obtained from special [[Zealot|Portal Frame Zealots]] that spawn rarely after killing a normal [[Zealot]] (1 in 420 chance) or after killing a [[Zealot Bruiser]] (1 in 380 chance). Zealots also drop a phoenix pet. [[Obsidian Defender]]s mostly drop obsidian, but they occasionally drop the [[Obsidian Chestplate]]. [[Seer]]s drop arrows and rarely drop the [[End Stone Bow]]. Both of these mobs have a Pray RNGesus chance to get Rare and Epic combat EXP boosts. There are also [[Ender Node]]s that can be found which drop additional resources ([[Experience Bottle]]s, [[Grand Experience Bottle]]s, [[End Stone]] or [[Obsidian]] (sometimes enchanted), [[Enchanted Ender Pearl]]s, reforge stones, and rarely [[Shrimp the Fish]]. Watch out for Nest Endermites though, as they can easily one or two shot a newer player. They drop mite gel, which can be sold for a lot of money. {{NPCSprite|Pearl Dealer}} - Has a shop outside the spawn platform featuring {{EnchantmentsLink|Gravity|tier=vi}}, [[End Stone]], [[Obsidian]], [[Remnant of the Eye]], [[Stonk]] and [[Silent Pearl]]s. {{NPCSprite|Guber}} - Provides a racing quest from one side of the island to another for rewards. === Dragon's Nest === {{See also|Dragon's Nest}} The '''Dragon's Nest''' is the boss room in The End. Its entrance is located at {{Coordinates|-600|22|-275}}. When eight [[Summoning Eye]]s are used on the altar in the center, the [[Ender Dragon]] spawns. There are seven Ender dragon types that can spawn, each one has a different amount of health, and their own [[Armor]] pieces and [[Dragon Fragment]]s. There are several sub-sections of the Dragon's nest, which contain teleport pads. *"'''Dragon's View'''" is one, and contains a Teleport Pad to "Endertower." Dragon's View is a tall sandstone and obsidian tower. It is located at {{Coordinates|-713|41|-317}}. === Void Sepulture === {{See also|Void Sepulture}} The '''Void Sepulture''' is an area in The End designed for players wanting to grind [[Enderman Slayer]] located at {{Coordinates|-576|7|-317}}. It houses endermen with much higher health and damage, named the [[Voidling Fanatic]] and [[Voidling Extremist]]. It is recommended to only go here if you have enough gear with which you know you won't die easily because [[Remnant of the Eye|Remnants of the Eye]] do not work inside the Void Sepulture. In the Void Sepulture, Voidling Fanatics and Voidling Extremists can drop enchanted ender pearls. Voidling Extremists can also drop Enderman Cortex Rewriter. === Zealot Bruiser Hideout === {{See also|Zealot Bruiser Hideout}} The '''Zealot Bruiser Hideout''' is an area in The End designed for stronger players to grind for [[Summoning Eye]]s without cluttering the Dragon's Nest. The Zealot Bruiser Hideout is the only area in which [[Zealot Bruiser]]s naturally spawn. == Zones == {{:Locations/The End}} == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Fairy Souls == {{Fairy Souls}} == Lore == *After the attack of the [[Dragon Emperor]], known as [[The Calamity|{{DarkRed|The Calamity}}]], the core of the Dragon's [[Fel Magic]] was placed on this island, which corrupted it to its today's state and created new fauna. == Trivia == *Voidgloom Seraphim can only spawn in {{zone|the end}}. *The creation of the island is described in [[Journal|Dungeon Journal - Memories]]. *There is a secret room containing 2 headless armor stands, one fairy soul, and multiple chests and cobwebs. According to [[Dungeon Journals#Memories|Dungeon Journal Memories]], it was [[Kaeman]]'s lab for studying the [[Fel Magic]] to revive his family, who have been killed by the [[Calamity|{{darkRed|Calamity}}]]. He failed to revive them, however, a side effect of one of his spells merged their dead bodies with his, adding 2 heads turning him into a Wither. **It can be accessed by going left on the outside of the island to {{Coords|-660|35|-190}} and going inside of the hole below the obsidian spike. *The "Travel to the End" objective is only completed if the player uses the [[Launch Pad]] in the {{zone|Spider's Den}}, not if they use a portal or a warp scroll. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/Oct 13|Added [[Lone Adventurer]]|Added [[Void Slate]].|Added [[Zealot Bruiser Hideout]].}} |beta= {{History|2019/August 2|Added '''The End'''.}} {{History|2021/May 31|Added [[Void Sepulture]].}} {{History|0.16|Added [[Lone Adventurer]]|Added [[Void Slate]].|Added [[Zealot Bruiser Hideout]].}} }} == Gallery == DragonsDen.png|The Dragon's Nest 2019-08-03_17.12.05.png|The End as seen while entering 2020-01-15_04.42.15.png|The Dragon's nest entrance, with zealots in the background. 2020-03-25_15.18.19.png|Announcement when you first reach the end 2020-04-26_18.44.25.png|Other side of the entrance to the Dragon's nest == Navigation == {{Nav/Locations}} {{Nav/Lore}}
